summary: Assess LLM deployment risks, protect data, and document controls through practical security labs. Explore the course and plan your training.
lede: LLM security training helps security leaders, architects, and AI delivery teams assess deployment risks and set safeguards for large language model applications. Participants practise threat modeling, tracing sensitive data flows, comparing hosted and open-weight models, and checking prompt and output controls. They also document risk treatments and prepare evidence for security, privacy, and legal reviews, including reviews of provider risks and shadow AI.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, build, secure, govern, or approve LLM applications and need a practical way to document deployment risks.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with enterprise information security, data protection, AI delivery, or technology risk is recommended. No programming is required to complete the risk-assessment and application-control exercises.
